title: Jogger F1 Cucumber - 2x Mini Plug Plants - High Yield Bitter Free
description:
Early, High-Yielding, Bitter-Free Cucumbers for Greenhouse & Outdoor Growing!


KEY FEATURES
• Early and Abundant Yield: Enjoy a continuous supply of fresh cucumbers for weeks.
• Bitter-Free & Delicious: Crisp, juicy flesh with a mild, fresh flavour, perfect for slicing.
• Disease Resistant: High tolerance to powdery mildew, downy mildew, and cucumber viruses.
• Versatile Growing: Ideal for greenhouses, tunnels, or sheltered outdoor locations.
• Uniform & Attractive Fruits: Produces beautifully straight, glossy green cucumbers, 18-22 cm long.


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Cucumis sativus 'Jogger F1'
Colour: Dark green (fruit)
Season: Harvest from July to October (fruiting)
Growth Habit: Climbing/Trailing (vining)
Flavour: Fresh, mild, juicy, crisp, and completely bitter-free
Time to Harvest: Early production, continuous harvest for many weeks


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun (6-8 hours daily)
Soil: Airy, humus-rich, well-draining soil (pH 6.0-7.0)
Watering: Water regularly and deeply, keeping compost moist but not wet. Increase frequency in hot weather.
Spacing: 45cm (18") apart in rows, 90cm (36") between rows (outdoor); 2 plants per growbag (greenhouse)
Height: Up to 3m (9') when trained
Spread: 45cm (18")
Hardiness: Half-hardy (requires protection from frost, minimum 12°C night temperature for outdoor planting)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in a warm, sheltered spot with full sun. For outdoor growing, acclimatise plants gradually over 7-10 days before transplanting.
• Train plants upwards along string, mesh, or canes to encourage straight fruits and maximise yield. Pinch out sideshoots after two leaves once fruit develops.
• Water regularly and deeply at the base of the plant, avoiding wetting the leaves. Maintain consistent moisture.
• Harvest cucumbers regularly when 18-22 cm long to encourage continuous production. Pick fruits whilst young and tender.
• Apply a balanced fertiliser every 4-6 weeks for optimal growth and fruit development.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants


DISPATCH
